name: Ingram Festival Shopping Center
summary: Ingram Festival Shopping Center is a community retail destination on San Antonio's Northwest Loop 410, offering convenient access to everyday shopping and dining options. The center serves the northwest San Antonio market with a practical mix of national retailers and local businesses.
demographics: Ingram Festival Shopping Center serves the northwest San Antonio market, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding residential neighborhoods. The trade area encompasses a diverse demographic mix with a significant Hispanic population, typical of San Antonio's northwest corridor, along with military families from nearby Lackland Air Force Base. Shoppers tend to be value-conscious consumers seeking convenient access to everyday retail and dining options, with household incomes ranging from $40,000 to $75,000 annually.
description: Ingram Festival Shopping Center is a well-established community shopping destination located along Northwest Loop 410 in San Antonio, Texas. Strategically positioned in the city's northwest corridor, this open-air center serves as a convenient retail hub for the surrounding residential communities and nearby military installations. The center features a diverse mix of national retailers, local businesses, and dining establishments that cater to the everyday needs of San Antonio families. With its accessible location along one of the city's major thoroughfares, Ingram Festival provides easy parking and a straightforward shopping experience for time-conscious consumers. The center has maintained its relevance in the competitive San Antonio retail market by offering a practical blend of value-oriented retailers and service providers that reflect the needs of its diverse customer base.
